scope: all 168 sealed R171 ordinary direction records, including fallback; 60 already audited dual-identity records
stem: unchanged source point and RGB fusion and decoder anchors; use the R76 native matching odds from an intervention under the full and D texts
intervention: remove the native projected visual value contribution for the physical conditioning region from only the corresponding other-entity content tokens in the final cross encoder; retain attention weights, all other outputs, and the output projection bias
box_association: same-forward source query for native boxes; original points overlap for non-query subject boxes, with a unique best physical Jaccard at least 0.25 and 3 common sampled points
eligibility: grounded LEFT or RIGHT rewrite, 3 unique visible seeds in both endpoint supports, an available query proxy for each endpoint, at least two eligible instances per role; a disjoint query vocabulary is never matched by query index
pair_readout: mean reciprocal drop in native matching log odds, clipped at +/-1 in log odds units. Double-center the eligible rectangle, treating other positions as absent information. Preserve UNKNOWN as in R171
control: same two passes, same raw odds, row plus column evidence alone; old signed LEFT/RIGHT factor held constant for all joint comparisons. Mismatch rolls the interaction columns by a hashed nonzero offset
readout_selection: original R171 role pools and PCA endpoints
confirmatory_gate: on both exposed panels report directional-macro Acc25, Acc50, mIoU and verified endpoint identities; advance only if the interaction yields convincing dual-identity and final localization gains over the same-evidence controls and the mismatched interaction in both panels; any advance then needs ordinary recording-separated validation
